title: A + B Problem
description:
Read two integers a and b from a single line and output their sum a + b.

This is the classic first problem of every Online Judge. It is used to verify that compilation, execution, time/memory limits and output comparison (with trailing whitespace/newline tolerance) all work end-to-end.
input: A single line containing two integers a and b (-10^9 <= a, b <= 10^9).
output: Output a single integer: the value of a + b.
note: Your output may contain extra trailing spaces or a trailing newline — the judge compares values after stripping trailing whitespace and trailing blank lines.
